scripts.build: bun scripts/sync-excalidraw-fonts.mjs && bun run check:breve-runtime && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:mac: bash scripts/predmg-clean.sh && bun run tauri build --bundles app
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:breve && bun run test:tooling
scripts.test:evals: bun test src/ai/hybrid.test.ts src/ai/loop.test.ts src/ai/models.test.ts src/ai/prompt.test.ts src/chatMemory/retrieval.test.ts src/chatMemory/workflow.test.ts
scripts.test:breve: bun breve-runtime/tests/test-actions.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-intents.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-timectx.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-retention.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-pdf-theme.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-doctor-findings.ts && bun test ./breve-runtime/tests/test-secret-stdin.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-process-lock.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-delivery-claim.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-watcher-failure.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-safe-fetch-fixtures.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-markdown-text.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-config-locality.ts
scripts.test:regression: bun run test && bun run test:evals && bun run check:breve-runtime && bun run check:design-system
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && bun run format:check && bun run check:code-shape && bun run check:hex && bun run check:architecture && bun run check:ipc && bun run check:secret-parity && bun run check:parity && bun run check:structure && bun run check:security && bun run check:docs && bun run lint:eslint
scripts.check:breve-runtime: bun build breve-runtime/scripts/*.ts --target bun --outdir $(mktemp -d) && tsc --noEmit -p breve-runtime && bash -n breve-runtime/scripts/morning-brief.sh && bash -n breve-runtime/scripts/lunch-brief.sh && bash -n breve-runtime/scripts/night-brief.sh && bun run check:breve-contract
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test:regression
